expected_output.original_request_summary: Client requests a COI for EMP 3 Solutions, Inc with Coastal Ridge Builders as certificate holder but provided no address, and lookup could not confirm one.

spanish.teaching_point: The Spanish reply rules, locked in: name-comma opener, envíame (never mándame), certificate holder stays in English inside the Spanish sentence, closes with Saludos, and no dashes anywhere. And the anti-fabrication rule: a generic holder name with no address and no certain lookup means ask, never invent an address.

spanish.teaching_point: A missing ZIP is missing information in any language: never guess it (Miami alone has 50+ ZIPs). The Spanish missing-ZIP template keeps ZIP code in English, opens with the name and a comma, ends with Saludos, and contains no dashes.
